title: EcoCard: Making Payments and Managing Your Account
summary: This document explains EcoCard payment management: minimum monthly payment is 1.0% of outstanding balance (plus past due amounts/fees), pay by the due date to avoid a $32.50 late fee, and monitor 19.99% standard APR, $50.00 annual fee, and 1.0% foreign transaction fee. It also covers credit limits ($5,000–$50,000 typical), how to set up funding, enroll in autopay, schedule one-time payments, confirm posting, and manage virtual cards (create/lock/delete).
faqs: What is the minimum monthly payment for my EcoCard and what is included in it?
When do I need to pay to avoid the late fee, and how much is the late payment fee?
What APR and fees should I monitor (annual fee and foreign transaction fee)?
How do I set up payments (funding account, autopay options, and one-time payments)?
How can I avoid paying interest—should I pay more than the minimum?
How do the EcoCard virtual card management features work (create/lock/delete)?
keywords: Minimum monthly payment = 1.0% of outstanding balance
